manifest.title: Negotiation Table
manifest.description: Two parties negotiate under the typed bargaining protocol: stated interests, opening proposals, bargaining rounds against a quoted concession ledger, arbitration only if no unanimous agreement is signed, and a final synthesis quoting the ledger. For a human arbiter, assign a human principal as the arbiter role — every synthesis then waits on that person (the save warns about it).

requiredRoles.description: Arbitrates if bargaining fails; synthesizes the outcome (may be a human principal)

config.name: Negotiation Table
config.description: Typed two-party bargaining with a concession ledger and arbitration fallback
